name: jobhunt.select
description: Jobhunt 0-10 gating and ordering for candidate selection. state = the posting's employer text plus the candidate's known eligibility and the dedupe result. Target 250K base, 200K base floor, 325K all-in is aspiration only. Produces both the go/no-go and the order to apply in.

f1_base_pay_verified.instructions: Whether applicable base pay is verified from employer text at or above the target
criteria: 0: unknown pay or below the $200K base floor
2: a broad range whose minimum is below the floor
3: a range that merely overlaps the floor
4: a range with a stated minimum but not tied to location
5: employer-stated base range whose minimum meets the $200K floor for this location
6: 5's level plus the range comes from the posting, not an aggregator
7: 6's level plus the maximum reaches $250K
8: 7's level plus the midpoint is at or above $250K
9: 8's level plus the band is stated for the exact location being applied to
10: 9's level plus band, bonus and equity are each separately identified

f2_location_and_travel.instructions: Whether location, remote or onsite status and travel are verified and owner-answered where required
criteria: 0: unverified
2: location known, remote status unknown
3: remote status known, travel unknown
4: travel stated qualitatively only
5: location and hybrid or onsite status verified from the posting
6: 5's level plus travel percentage stated
7: 6's level plus Denver or remote is explicit
8: 7's level plus relocation, if required, is an owner answer on file
9: 8's level plus the requirement matches what Mike has already confirmed
10: 9's level plus no location or travel answer is borrowed from another employer

f3_authorization_sponsorship.instructions: Whether work authorization and sponsorship answers are truthful and sourced
criteria: 0: invented or unanswered on a required field
2: answered, source is an undated note
3: sponsorship answered generally, not for this employer
4: authorization answered, prior-employment question unanswered
5: authorization and sponsorship answered with a dated source
6: 5's level plus prior-employment questions answered per employer
7: 6's level plus the source reference is recorded in the packet
8: 7's level plus no optional disclosure is inferred
9: 8's level plus every required legal answer has its own evidence row
10: 9's level plus all answers are consistent with filings already made

f4_real_vacancy.instructions: Whether this is an active vacancy rather than a talent pool or future opening
criteria: 0: a talent pool or future-opening listing
2: a requisition id but no live page check
3: a requisition id with a stale page check
4: live page checked more than 14 days ago
5: active requisition verified live within the last 7 days
6: 5's level plus the posting names a team or manager
7: 6's level plus the req has an age of 0 to 7 days
8: 7's level plus there is an inbound signal or a warm contact
9: 8's level plus the req is behind a relationship that can move it
10: 9's level plus he is applying before the req is widely visible

f5_dedupe_clean.instructions: Whether employer, requisition, portal and mail history are all clear of a prior attempt
criteria: 0: hits a PARKED or uncertain record
2: req matches a prior attempt with unknown outcome
3: req matches a prior attempt that was rejected
4: employer overlap only, no req match
5: no employer plus requisition match in the ledger, mail or portal
6: 5's level plus a canonical URL check is recorded
7: 6's level plus the mail box has been searched for this req
8: 7's level plus the portal history is clear
9: 8's level plus any manual application by Luca has been reconciled
10: 9's level plus the dedupe evidence is timestamped and stored

g1_lane_fit_for_order.instructions: Lane fit for ranking the day's candidates
criteria: 0: excluded lane
2: one lane signal conflicts
3: ambiguous lane
4: adjacent lane with a bridge
5: squarely the target lane, stated once
6: 5's level plus no competing lane signal
7: 6's level plus the lane is named in the headline
8: 7's level plus evidenced by two roles
9: 8's level plus reinforced by scope
10: 9's level plus their lane words describe him

g2_band_distance_from_target.instructions: How far the base band sits from the $250K target
criteria: 0: at or below the $200K floor
2: maximum at $215K
3: maximum at $230K
4: midpoint at $235K
5: maximum at $250K
6: midpoint at $250K
7: midpoint at $265K
8: midpoint at $285K
9: midpoint at or above $300K
10: 9's level plus the band is narrow and the floor is well clear of $250K

g3_evidence_reuse.instructions: How much of an already-cleared packet can be reused
criteria: 0: everything must be rewritten from scratch
2: a quarter is reusable
3: a third is reusable
4: half is reusable but the top third must change
5: half is reusable with one paragraph rewritten
6: 60 percent reusable, summary and two bullets change
7: 70 percent reusable, summary changes only
8: 80 percent reusable, one clause changes
9: reuses a cleared packet with a cover note only
10: reuses a cleared packet unchanged and the target's top requirement is already answered
0: posted 30 or more days ago
2: 15 to 21 days
3: 11 to 14 days
4: 8 to 10 days
5: posted 5 to 7 days ago
6: 3 to 4 days
7: 1 to 2 days
8: posted today
9: today plus a warm signal in the last week
10: an inbound or referred path that expires within days

g5_competition_heuristics.instructions: How crowded the field is likely to be
criteria: 0: brand-name employer, easy apply, public 3 weeks
2: easy apply on any board
3: a niche board only
4: a niche board plus a domain requirement
5: a domain requirement most applicants will not meet
6: 5's level plus a second unusual requirement (clearance, sector tenure)
7: 6's level plus the req sits behind a smaller company
8: 7's level plus there is a referral path in reach
9: 8's level plus the req is unadvertised or very new
10: 9's level plus he would be one of very few people in the world for it

g6_ordering_rule.instructions: Whether today's batch is ordered by fit, band and reuse before any volume goal
criteria: 0: ordered by nothing, applied in list order
2: ordered by band only
3: ordered by band and recency
4: ordered by fit and band but volume forced the tail
5: the top three by fit plus band plus reuse were prepared first
6: 5's level plus nothing below a 5 on g1 was prepared at all
7: 6's level plus the tail was cut rather than padded
8: 7's level plus each prepared item names its one reason it ranks here
9: 8's level plus the order survives a re-read with no reshuffle
10: 9's level plus the ordering rule is written down and followed daily

rules.reason: base pay is not verified at or above the $200K floor for this location; do not spend a packet on it
duplicate or uncertain prior attempt; reconcile before any further work
required legal answer missing or unsourced
the day's batch was not ordered by fit, band and reuse before volume

notes: Base, bonus, OTE and equity are separate quantities; never substitute one for another. Unknown pay is never a pass. 325K all-in never satisfies f1. Ordering question g6 exists because a score that only informs is a dashboard: the number must choose the order. Advisory while calibrated:false. SCALE CORRECTION 2026-09-22: the live Jev API hard-caps score levels at 10 ("Too many score levels. Must have at most 10 levels"), contradicting the typesafe-jev skill doc which claims max 11. This pack therefore carries 10 levels labelled 0,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10: the single "just above 0" filler rung was removed and every anchor label and body kept verbatim, so 0 = bad, 5 = average and 10 = world class still hold and rule thresholds (5.0) are unchanged. Operating goal is 9.5 on the 0-10 label scale. If the returned mean proves index-based (max 8 over 10 rungs) rather than label-based, the equivalent goal is 8.55 and the next run must say so rather than rescale silently.
